reviews.text: Every time we walk by, my dog tries to pull me in because she gets treated so well and gets given so many tasty liver treats during her vet visits!
I really appreciate all the staff and vets at Woodbine Animal clinic - they are kind, knowledgeable and very caring.

What's also amazing is that there are a group of vets so you can pick one or meet with whoever is available. I don't have favorite - they are all great, they all hit the key points and bring their own approach to it which adds to the experience. character and expertise - great combo

I've been taking my pets to Woodbine animal clinic for over 30 years. Awesome place, great vets over the years and excellent care of my cats. Thank you.

4 months later.  March 2026  Follow up visit for thyroid and kidney.

Annual visit.  It went great. This means he didn't scratch it bite.  He gets gabapentin pre visit so he's more manageable but, still growls a lot. He gets excellent care and I'm very appreciative of this. I also get relevant information which I sometimes forget. 😏. 😿😾😸

Awesome vet. We have tried several in the east end and this one is the best!

All of the staff at Woodbine Animal Clinic are incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. I have relied on all of them from the front desk, to the vet techs to my primary vet, and when she is not available the other vets, over the past 8 months while navigating my dogs treatment for hemangiosarcoma (malignant tumour). Within two weeks I was not only referred to a surgeon but my 7 yr old bouvier, Flinder, had a very large tumour removed from his abdomen. Then 12 weeks of chemo and consultation with a cardiologist, co-ordinated by the Woodbine team. Now Flinder has some cardiac complications from the chemo and again, the Woodbine team has ensured Flinder is getting the best care and living his best life. He is doing great and I couldn't be more grateful. Highly recommend this team for their personal and professional dedication to Flinder's care.
I have been going to this clinic for 20 years. The best.

I’ve been to a number of clinics over the years, and while I’ve had some very good vets, my experience at Woodbine Animal Clinic was honestly exceptional. Dr. Emily was absolutely incredible with my dog Abby during her dental procedure. She was compassionate, thorough, patient, and took the time to explain everything clearly. The pricing was also fair and reasonable, which I truly appreciated.

What really stood out to me, though, was the entire staff. From the moment you walk in, you can tell the assistants and vet techs genuinely care about animals. Everyone was warm, attentive, kind, and professional, and Abby immediately seemed comfortable and well cared for there.

I was so impressed with the care and professionalism that I’ve already recommended them to a friend for her dog’s dental.

This clinic is a 10/10 in my opinion, and I genuinely can’t imagine going anywhere else now. Highly recommend.

I did not have a good experience at this clinic.  My initial call was great; I spoke with Heather who understood the situation with my fur-baby and booked me as soon as possible but the visit did not go well at all.  It took almost two hours to be seen for about 10 minutes with a tech and 10 minutes with the vet who did not introduce herself; the tech was great but the vet did not show any love of animals and had zero bedside manner.  I thought since it took so long to be seen, I would not be charged for the visit but more fool I, because in the end, I paid $340 (plus tax) for the visit ($142) and a urine test that was conducted on site and took 5 minutes…and it was not enough that they charged $137 For the test, they charged an additional $61 to collect the urine which only took a few minutes…this is price gouging imo.   And because I wanted liquid antibiotics, the cost was going to be an additional $89 so a total of almost $500 (after tax) for a UTI.  Absurd.  And, you are not paying high prices because it is a modern, state-of-the-art clinic; the room I was in had an old wooden desk that had seen better days and had been patched up with plywood. And it was also unbearably hot which the tech acknowledged as a problem in that room so they know they have issues but do not fix them.  Lastly, it is really difficult to find parking in this area. Update: the manager, Beth took my feedback seriously which helped mitigate my dissatisfaction so I added two stars.
Great and compassionate care. Extremely friendly staff. Prices are slightly higher than other vets. Medication can usually be found cheaper online.
